About The Role HanmiGlobal is seeking a Project Manager to coordinate and lead construction and development projects from planning through delivery. In this role, you will work closely with clients, designers, contractors, consultants, and internal teams to establish project goals and turn them into practical plans. You will monitor progress, resolve issues, and help ensure that work is completed in accordance with approved requirements, applicable regulations, and agreed timelines and budgets. This position suits a proactive professional who can balance strategic oversight with attention to detail. You will communicate regularly with stakeholders, provide clear reporting, and help maintain alignment as project needs evolve. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound judgment, a strong commitment to responsible project delivery, and the ability to build productive working relationships across multidisciplinary teams. Qualifications Candidates should have a bachelor’s degree in construction management, civil engineering, architecture, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills are essential, along with the ability to manage competing priorities and follow through on commitments. Candidates should be comfortable collaborating with stakeholders at different levels and addressing project challenges in a practical, solutions-focused manner. Familiarity with project management software and standard office applications is beneficial. Relevant professional certifications, licenses, or additional training may be considered an advantage, depending on the requirements of the project and location. Responsibilities Lead day-to-day coordination of assigned projects, ensuring that scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety objectives are understood and actively managed. Review progress against approved plans and communicate issues, changes, and dependencies to relevant stakeholders. Support procurement, contract administration, design reviews, construction coordination, inspections, and project documentation as required. Help ensure that project activities comply with applicable codes, regulations, contractual obligations, and organizational procedures. Facilitate meetings, document decisions, and follow up on action items. Promote clear communication and constructive collaboration across project teams. Specific compensation, benefits, and working arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process. Equal Opportunity HanmiGlobal is committed to providing a fair and respectful workplace. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, relevant experience, business needs, and applicable law. We welcome applications from qualified candidates and do not tolerate discrimination or harassment on any legally protected basis.
